ownerDecisions.decision: A — /admin is PROOVRA platform administration only; the 11 workspace-scoped pages move to tenant destinations with tested redirects. No cross-tenant selector.
Explicit read capabilities identity.sso.read and identity.audit.read, deliberately assigned; a generic VIEWER label is not the authority; secrets never projected.
Hide Organization Admin navigation for personal workspaces; a direct URL shows a truthful bounded entitlement state.
Resolve stays offered where operator-resolvable; the backend projects resolutionAuthority/resolvableByOperator/refusalCode/runbookDestination and each refusal code has its own copy.
Verified TOTP satisfies step-up; SMS/WhatsApp remain supported alternatives.
ORG_SECURITY_ADMIN gets verified-domain read and write (mutation behind step-up, confirmation, audit); ORG_AUDITOR read-only; members none; platform admin does not cross tenants.

Matters support per-case restricted access: build the matter Access tab (list grants, grant to an active workspace member, revoke), warning that the first grant restricts the case and the last revoke reopens it.
Discussion thread contributor access and thread subscriptions are not offered: retire POST/DELETE contributors and POST/DELETE subscribe.

Workspace-level coding-schema authoring (publish) and workflow-template authoring (create, edit, archive) are not in scope: templates stay platform-managed and workspaces use the seeded coding schemas; retire the routes.
On-demand similarity reconciliation and the manual trust-article needs-review flag are not product capabilities: retire reconcile-similarity and trust article review.
Evidence declaration statements are written by the requester when the declaration is requested, and the recorded statement is the only text that can be signed.

Design choice (recorded, D30): the break-glass emergency user is an active ORG_ADMIN or owner of the organization. No per-organization emergency-user list is kept, because that would need a migration.

backendUiReconciliation.reason: The 'Ask in plain language' card was WITHDRAWN from /search for every workspace type after an audit of what it displayed, so this route is deliberately unmounted rather than accidentally orphaned. Two defects, both in runStateQuery: (1) two of its seven presets synthesise titles instead of reading the record's name — REVIEW_BACKLOG renders 'Review <id8>… (STATUS)' and REPORTS_RECENT renders 'Report v<n>' while routing to /evidence/:id; (2) the state presets query prisma.evidence / evidenceReviewWorkflow / report directly on teamId alone, bypassing the reviewer-restriction gate executeSearch applies twice, so a non-reviewer saw rows ordinary Search withholds. Cross-workspace leakage was NOT possible — authorizeOrFail verifies ACTIVE membership in body.teamId and every state query carries it. The route is retained (registered, authorized, rate-limited, audited) because this repository does not delete routes; the TEXT_SEARCH branch is unaffected as it delegates to executeSearch. Reintroduction requires: state presets through the authorized search path, canonical display names, a real total rather than the page length, and demonstrated value over ordinary Search.
